findings.current: Fearing that women who married out might leak the family’s martial arts and secrets, the clan took in male in-laws and had them carry on the Tang surname.
findings.defect: “Male in-laws” omits the specific live-in son-in-law arrangement by which the clan retained its daughters and continued the Tang surname.
findings.rationale: 데릴사위 specifically means a son-in-law brought into the wife’s household, not merely any male relative by marriage.
findings.replacement: Fearing that daughters who married out might leak the clan’s martial arts and secrets, the clan instead took in live-in sons-in-law and had them carry on the Tang surname.
findings.source: 출가외인(出嫁外人)이 가문의 무공과 기밀을 누출할까 염려한 탓에 데릴사위를 들여 당씨 성을 잇게 했다.

findings.current: Hurry! Spread out and bring a Divine Physician!
findings.defect: The indefinite article turns the established, specific Divine Physician into any physician bearing that description.
findings.rationale: 신의 is the specific honorific used for the physician already treating the major patients.
findings.replacement: Hurry! Spread out and bring the Divine Physician!

findings.current: Even though nine-tenths of the building had been damaged, the pavilion had somehow remained standing. It was currently being used as a temporary treatment room for important patients.
findings.defect: The draft says nine-tenths of this particular building was damaged, whereas the source says nearly nine-tenths of the clan’s buildings were damaged and this pavilion retained its form.
findings.rationale: 건물이 is plural in context, while 형태를 유지한 전각 identifies the surviving pavilion separately.
findings.replacement: Although nearly nine-tenths of the buildings had been damaged, this pavilion had somehow remained intact. It was currently being used as a temporary treatment room for important patients.
findings.source: 구 할에 달하는 건물이 파손되는 와중에도 용케 형태를 유지한 전각은, 중요한 환자들을 모아 둔 임시 의방(醫方)으로 쓰이는 중이었다.

findings.current: Since we’re on the subject, Mungyeong may be skilled for his age, but isn’t he a little too young to take charge of the squad?
findings.defect: Mungyeong is being entrusted with the squad leader as a patient, not placed in command of the squad.
findings.rationale: 조장을 맡기다 means to leave the squad leader in Mungyeong’s care; the following discussion of the Divine Physician and critical patients confirms the medical context.
findings.replacement: Since we’re on the subject, Mungyeong may be skilled for his age, but isn’t he a little too young for us to entrust our squad leader to him?
findings.source: 말이 나왔으니 말인데, 문경이가 나이에 비해서 실력이 좋긴 하지만 조장을 맡기기에는 좀 그렇지 않습니까?

findings.current: Thank God they had survived. What would they have done if they had died?
findings.defect: The second sentence assigns the consequence to the dead men themselves instead of expressing Jin Taekyung’s alarm over what he would have done if they had died.
findings.rationale: The omitted subject is resolved by Jin Taekyung’s first-person concern; asking what dead people would have done reverses that perspective.
findings.replacement: Thank God they had survived. What would I have done if they had died?
findings.source: 목숨을 건졌기에 망정이지, 죽었으면 어쩔 뻔했나.

findings.current: Some clasped their hands before their chests. Some bowed their heads slightly. Others prostrated themselves deeply.
findings.defect: The first gesture is rendered as generic clasped hands rather than the specific martial fist-and-palm salute.
findings.rationale: 포권 is a distinct martial greeting and mark of respect, contrasting with the bows and prostrations that follow.
findings.replacement: Some gave a fist-and-palm salute. Some bowed their heads slightly. Others prostrated themselves deeply.
findings.source: 누군가는 포권을 취하고, 누군가는 작게 고개를 숙였으며, 누군가는 깊이 엎드려 절했다.

findings.current:
> **System**
>
> - Well done.

I smiled along with Jeok Cheongang.
findings.defect: The draft falsely presents “Well done” as a System notification, changing its speaker and severing it from Jeok Cheongang, whom Jin has just spotted.
findings.rationale: The actual System panel ends before Jin spots Jeok Cheongang; 잘했다 is Jeok Cheongang’s acknowledgment, followed by Jin returning his smile.
findings.replacement:
“Well done.”

I smiled back at Jeok Cheongang.

findings.current: Do not say what you just said in front of Doctor Mun—no, Mungyeong. Especially not in front of Mungyeong.
findings.defect: “Doctor Mun” invents a professional title and erases Cheongpung’s revealing false start on 문 할, which points toward an elder-style form of address before he corrects himself.
findings.rationale: 문 할 is deliberately cut off before completion; preserving the interrupted “Grandfa—” retains the pragmatic cue without completing information the source withholds.
findings.replacement: What you just said—don’t say it in front of Grandfa—no, especially not in front of Mungyeong.
findings.source: 방금 하셨던 말, 문 할. 아니 문경이 앞에서는 특히 하지 마세요.

findings.current: The martial world of Sichuan had united and cast an inescapable net across the region.
findings.defect: The established term 무림 is translated descriptively instead of using the binding term “Murim.”
findings.rationale: The glossary explicitly binds 무림 to “Murim.”
findings.replacement: The Sichuan Murim had united and cast an inescapable net across the region.

findings.current: had been caught by some unknown weirdo.
findings.defect: “Weirdo” adds flippant ridicule to a serious summary that identifies the captor only as a mysterious, unidentified figure.
findings.rationale: 정체 모를 emphasizes unknown identity, while 괴인 here denotes an enigmatic or extraordinary person rather than supplying the draft’s mocking register.
findings.replacement: had been caught by a mysterious figure.

findings.current: > - You have acquired a new nickname!
findings.defect: “Nickname” is too casual for 별호, the martial epithet publicly attached to Jin Taekyung.
findings.rationale: 별호 denotes a sobriquet or martial epithet, especially in the context of the newly proclaimed “Blazing Fire Divine Dragon.”
findings.replacement: > - You have acquired a new epithet!

summary: Several factual and attribution errors alter quantities, responsibility, subjects, and speaker identity; additional issues weaken a revealing register shift and established terminology.
